_comment: Build-loop targets. The loop scripts know nothing about any particular
codebase; a target profile tells them where to work, what to stage and how
to verify. Adding a target is a data edit, not a script change.
A run picks its target from, in order: an explicit --target flag, the
backlog's top-level "target" field, .digest-meta.json, then the default
verify.* are npm script names run in the target repo. Omit one to skip that
